description: Adds "cartoon" to template_category: an 8th template, alongside the 7 motion-graphics ones, rendering a scene as two SVG puppet characters in a reusable background instead of a stock image. See engine/prompts/cartoon_visual_planner for the template_data shape it expects (background/camera/characters). MINOR bump per RFC 0007: widens the enum only, on the same string type; existing 1.0.0-1.2.0 artifacts stay valid.

search_terms.description: Concrete photographable subjects for AI image generation. Unused (but still required by this schema) on a "cartoon" scene - asset_collector skips the fetch for any scene with template_category set.

template_category.description: If set, this scene uses a motion graphics template instead of (or overlaid on) the AI image. Each value maps to exactly one hand-built composition. The first 7 are documented in engine/prompts/visual_planner; "cartoon" is documented in engine/prompts/cartoon_visual_planner.

template_data.description: JSON-encoded props for the template. Examples: {"events":[{"year":"1947","title":"Independence"}],"title":"Timeline"} for timeline, {"items":[{"name":"China","value":"1.4B"}],"title":"Top"} for ranking, {"value":"4,300 km","label":"LENGTH"} for counter, {"leftLabel":"BEFORE","leftValue":"$100","rightLabel":"AFTER","rightValue":"$10,000"} for comparison. For cartoon: {"background":{"location":"bedroom","variant":"night","tone":"scary"},"camera":{"type":"pan","panFrom":0,"panTo":-80},"characters":[{"characterId":"pilot","x":260,"y":380,"isSpeaking":true,"expression":"surprised"}]}.
